policy.purpose: 重要能力先设计再实施；判定及记录的唯一流程见 docs/development/repository-workflow.md#设计判定与记录。已登记 blocked-pending-design 能力命中匹配模式时，check_design_gate.py 拒绝实施。
policy.judgment_procedure: 按仓库工作流的五项判定检查本次能力与既有设计覆盖；命中后先落设计，登记 owner、designDoc、设计要点、有效匹配范围及退役条件。空模式或未登记能力不能由机器保证，仍须人工判定。
policy.approval: 先在仓库保存或修订设计文件，再将已明确方案与边界的条目标为 approved，并在 design_notes 说明裁决依据；未定部分保持 blocked-pending-design。落库不要求自动 Git 提交，提交/发布遵守用户授权。误报可凭具体产生者收窄模式并记录理由；不得只改状态绕过未完成设计。
policy.retirement: 能力实施并过验证门后，将稳定职责移交现有合同并删除该窄条目；未完成的独立范围继续登记，不把部分完成扩为整体批准。

areas.title: Scene HDR / tone mapping / EDR 输出管线
areas.design_notes: HDR Bloom extraction contract: designDoc#hdr-bloom-extraction. Existing first half-resolution pass thresholds completed-source pixels before area reduction; retain odd-edge coverage, color domain, controls, alpha and local optional failure without extra resources/owner. The original13 uniform acquisition quality remains unknown. New current-Ultra controls independently confirm five corresponding quantized points, with a separate new low-light off control; they do not retroactively qualify all13. Current-Ultra reversible wide-block spatial profiles are close to Native, while thin/point low-code JPEG remains bounded. The proposed spatial reconstruction replacement was withdrawn before product implementation; do not tune Bloom without a discriminating counterexample. Keep existing weights/targets/passes. Next source evidence belongs to actual model reflection/radiance/resolution; exact official HDRfloat/kernel/full-waterdrop/performance parity remains ungranted.

areas.title: 2D 材质光照 / PBR / 阴影 / 反射
areas.design_notes: StaticModel local composition contract: docs/scene/capabilities/advanced-object-coverage.md#model-subtree-raster. The nearest MainPass maps only clip XY of reverse-depth VP and supplies its XY-map winding to model color culling, preserving Z/W and original world/normal/light/shadow plus existing pass-scoped depth lifetime. Retire the model type rejection only with its consumer; retain the separate cold-hidden parent visibility/preparation boundary. No extra renderer, depth/resource owner, cache or ABI. Model normal-map design: designDoc#model-normal-map. Reuse the existing stock generic4 surface preparation, immutable normal texture/UV/sampling/typed encoding, current model tangent/normal and unique compositor. Standard orthonormal TBN preserves handedness under mirrored/nonuniform transforms; only direct lighting and reflection use the perturbation. Retire the missing-normal consumer and its reflection exclusion; missing optional input retains geometric lighting. No new resource/depth owner, cache, PSO family or frame parsing. Validate production GPU variants and two active author models; official exact pixels remain unverified. Model additive contract: designDoc#model-additive-blend. The existing parsed blending selects cold prepared RGB one/one model PSOs, composed with existing reflection. Preserve PMA/alpha-over, original depth/cull/caster and unique output. Missing PSO skips only its draw; retire the fixed source-over consumer. No new pass, resource/depth owner, sort or hot parse; verify production nonblack background, alpha/depth/cull and renamed inputs plus the active star model. Model depth state: designDoc#model-depth-state. The original compileMaterialPlan prepares blending once and effective camera test/write for the Entry. Qualified translucent model colour never writes camera depth despite stored enabled, while authored camera test, normal/additive rules and light-space caster/coverage remain independent. Retire the old translucent stored-write projection with its consumer; preserve authored order and existing reverse-depth states without new owner/PSO/ABI/bias or hot parsing. Validate real Earth shell interference and the six qualified official depth/order colour categories, including the entity-in-front test controls; camera-mismatched v1 research is excluded. No-test models terminate transparent image reorder ranges. The existing opaque VolumeOccluder carries the same camera test to depth-only writes in color order; keep light-space shadow state independent. Only one extra stencil, no PSO/pool/owner/cache/frame parsing. Verify literal depth/color, own full-App middle-surface and ordering controls, actual frame-to-volume propagation and unchanged authors. Model packed-map contract: docs/scene/capabilities/advanced-object-coverage.md#model-material-map. Replace old emissive-only texture and nullable draw triples with one prepared typed binding. Reuse TEX component metadata and original BRDF/reflection, consume RGBA once, preserve alpha/depth/legacy source qualification and local optional failure; retire zero-emission MR starvation and mapped-reflection exclusion, no new ABI bytes/owner/PSO/cache/hot analysis. Model gradient contract: docs/scene/capabilities/advanced-object-coverage.md#model-shading-gradient. Qualified stock model slot4 data/default and cold center-line/sampler binding replace only diffuse cosine in original shared SurfaceResponse; explicit noL and diffuse inputs avoid duplicate dot/BRDF/wrappers. Preserve image arithmetic, specular, per-lamp shadow/falloff and output/depth, with one 16B uniform and texture8/sampler3, no new PSO/cache/owner. Rim remains separate. Model rim contract: docs/scene/capabilities/advanced-object-coverage.md#model-rim-lighting. Two static profile values/one16B uniform drive a per-fragment symmetric view weight into original per-lamp diffuse cosine; keep shared BRDF API, lamp/shadow/output ownership and local malformed/dynamic value failure. No independent emission, enabled state, texture, PSO or owner; qualify metal/NoL/no-lamp/exponent0 boundaries and real lunar switches. Chroma surface contract: docs/scene/capabilities/advanced-object-coverage.md#model-chroma-surface. Existing profile qualifies two actual stock stage identities and carries static specular tint; one16B tint/mode uniform selects required surface-color/view-tint/HDR timing while shared BRDF, lamps, alpha/depth and generic4 arithmetic remain. Move coverage after implicit sampling/before lighting, retire duplicate exponent clamp, preserve mask-alpha and single reflection gain. Pigment/noise stays separate; no owner/cache/PSO/Frame expansion. Chroma pigment uses existing prepared binding and direct radiance; design: docs/scene/capabilities/advanced-object-coverage.md#model-chroma-pigment. Model shadow coverage: docs/scene/capabilities/advanced-object-coverage.md#model-shadow-coverage. Remove the translucent category rejection in existing Frame caster collection; preserve authored cast intent and existing >.5 material/layer/texture coverage across three shadow projections. No new owner, PSO, map, state or hot computation; keep camera depth and existing additive behavior independent. Spot radial falloff: docs/scene/capabilities/advanced-object-coverage.md#spot-radial-falloff. Use the existing shared surface radial owner: exponent0 means unit radial energy before radius cutoff; positive exponents keep exact prior cutoff/arithmetic. Retire only the zero-exponent hard range, preserve model/image consumers and independent spot cone/shadow/volume. Carry parsed finite nonnegative spot exponent through original Snapshot and two surface payloads; preserve independent cone, color/intensity/shadow, legacy beam and particle boundaries. Two16B vectors, no new owner/cache/PSO/resource/hot parsing; default2 arithmetic remains exact. Image explicit map components: docs/scene/capabilities/advanced-object-coverage.md#image-material-map-components. Existing Profile allowed/required and LitCapture prepare actual(header|required)&allowed once, all nonzero integer combos explicit, PNG header optional. Retire rawFlags and header permission, preserve effective bits during existing local alias recovery; no new owner/ABI/cache/Metal algorithm/format. Qualify actual parser/profile/loader/Metal and original App map/effect path, unchanged author135 default header consumer. Model albedo asset migration: designDoc#model-albedo-frames. One cold first-pass MaterialPlan supplies existing Catalog demands and original Script planning handoff; retire direct model slot0 loading/candidate residency. Existing FrameProvider/registry freezes one current binding for color/shadows. Keep local asset readiness separate from named dependency completeness, original geometry-before-handoff/cancel, cold actual-video consumer index, video independent demand and initial pending/paused-retry qualification; no new clock/worker/barrier/cache or media selection. Require original static outputs, animated-frame/crop MDL/App pixels and independent author. Pigment sprite-domain design: designDoc#model-pigment-frame-addressing. Original binding keeps full pixel-to-UV transform; only sprites prepare actual frame pixel extents floored at one target pixel and reciprocals, with a dedicated16B ABI tail. Existing addressMode chooses local repeat or texel-center clamp before the transform, retiring whole-atlas density/repeat for that domain; ordinary padding/axis/sampler behavior remains exact. No copied texture/owner/clock/cache or new admission gate; require raw Loader plus actual neighboring model pixels, wrong-period/edge negatives and independent author. Fractional linear footprint isolation is not claimed. Affine material-frame design: docs/scene/capabilities/render-graph-shader-coverage.md#material-affine-frames. Loader validates projected full-basis geometry/four-corner source bounds; fixed Lit and Generic remove unjustified positive-axis permission. Generic executes author UV and publishes complete companions, without hidden application; Derivation also retires SlotBinding duplication already implied by publication and active index facts. Preserve actual source/exact-scale consumers via renamed axisAlignedSourceUVTransform, no alias or new fallback owner. Require real Catalog, fixed Lit, model color/holes/shadow and Generic companion/raw controls; true invariants remain hard failures and fractional filtering claims stay bounded. Model normal consumers: designDoc#model-normal-consumers. Original Material pure demand (lighting/viewTint/potential reflection) selects one optional original normal computation per layer and part-local admission before named-input demand. Original two world entries each validate full finite world once; retire whole-layer invertibility permission and duplicate inner finite checks, keep original inline Double inverse-transpose only for real consumers and identity carrier otherwise, without an extra conversion helper or signature migration. Trust the sole immutable prepared normal from the Frame instead of rechecking its finite output. Preserve optional normal-map eligibility and position-only color/depth/shadow/volume, no cofactor/rank whitelist/owner/state/cache/ABI. Qualify rank-two plane pixels, mixed material isolation, actual depth and three shadows with invalid-world negatives and independent author. Material opacity: designDoc#model-material-opacity. Keep raw finite Double alpha through the proven model channel without premature Float permission; normalize once at original Resources.material before layer multiplication, fallback nonfinite legacy/builtin to existing1. Preserve other channel domains, authored malformed-input proof and dynamic/property/script boundaries. Retire both redundant Pipeline opacity finite checks only with the sole cold normalization; keep shadow coverage and true failure publication, no new helper/state/owner/cache/ABI/Metal algorithm. Require actual preparation-to-three-shadow readbacks, healthy independent caster App pixels and original author. Model HDR colour intermediates: designDoc#model-hdr-color-intermediates. Existing model colour/shadow source sampling and colour/coverage arithmetic remain Float until the original fog/PMA/Half storage projection. Retire legacy Half surface/lighting and PMA epsilon without a precision flag/PSO/ABI/state/owner or per-pixel finite gate. Preserve Chroma colour semantics, radiance qualification, zero-coverage and exact shadow threshold. Raw brightness finite admission follows the original HDR consumer flag; disabled HDR consumes1 and must not reject a draw for unused magnitude, while active HDR and authored Float boundaries remain unchanged. Default full-quality emissive response: designDoc#model-hdr-emissive-gain and docs/scene/architecture/runtime-architecture.md#effective-quality-policy. Preserve authored REFLECTION separately from strength in the existing surface profile; existing x.bit2 qualifies HDR advanced LIGHTING/REFLECTION response after reflection and brightness, before fog/PMA. Reuse the A sample, preserve author controls and old pre-A stage; no ABI growth, new resource/PSO/cache/owner or quality UI. Require real HDR-off, feature/strength/history negatives, reflected-radiance controls, renamed variants and stable author pixels; qualify feedback before altering the history owner. Qualify actual old/new HDR16 pixel factorization, small positive PMA/zero-straight boundaries, late tint/fog and three-lamp alpha sampling with whole-App and independent author; do not claim all Float32 algebra/half range solved. Tube segment contract: designDoc#tube-light. Preserve ltube as a distinct prepared/shared-frame line emitter under current world/visibility and the existing four-light budget. Model stock surfaces consume one closest-segment sample through shared radial/SurfaceResponse; no Point disguise, new renderer/resource/clock/history/compositor, pass, texture or PSO. Controlpoint local-endpoint policy needs qualified translation/rotation observations; do not grant official host coordinates from a source helper. Retire the missing Format/snapshot/model consumer only with fixed real can off/on and point-positive pixels plus existing light/alpha/depth regressions; shadow/volume/Generic/image tiers remain separate. Append bounded GPU records and keep the original Pipeline under1000 lines; SceneDocumentLoader reparses source bytes at launch and stores no SceneDocument/RenderDescriptor DTO, so this type addition needs no cache revision; existing shader source identity owns its compiled cache. Directional shadow fit: designDoc#model-directional-shadow-fit. Clip actual per-pass receiver boxes to their color raster clip domains using bidirectional edge intervals; fit existing single map to receiver/caster XY overlap and only relevant caster depth, decoupling XY padding from Z. Retire whole-world caster fitting without camera-culling valid offscreen occluders, changing coverage or adding map/ABI/history/cache owners. Require clipped-volume/degenerate-domain/group/named and actual real-asset temporal pixels before claiming quality.

Reuse an identical cached texture before recalculating logical cost; prepare continuations and rollback remain unconditional. Keep full-resolution sampling and existing color/refraction owners, no ROI protocol or new budget/cache owner. Verify real large BGRA/HDR capture, visible blend pixels, global/explicit rejection, dual-owner rollback and in-flight/final release. Small atlas UV: docs/scene/capabilities/render-graph-shader-coverage.md#small-atlas-frame-uv. Existing pure SceneTextureUVTransform owns one finite/nonzero determinant predicate, retiring SlotBinding private UV/area helpers and the duplicated StaticModel color/shadow isValid area epsilon. Existing raw-frame entries retain their original checks, physical/content/format and true-degeneracy bounds; no new owner/cache/ABI/work. Qualify genuine4096 atlas1px frame through Loader/publication/Metal and existing App, plus actual model color/three-light shadow equality; separate affine loader limits remain. Model single-frame TEX: docs/scene/capabilities/advanced-object-coverage.md#model-single-frame-texture. Existing Loader admits exactly one valid sprite frame as a static typed candidate in its original constructor, preserving atlas geometry and sprite provenance. Retire the blanket non-sprite rejection only for that constant frame; retain all multi-frame and original atlas/sampler/consumer bounds. No new owner/clock/state/cache/upload or hot parsing; require real MDL preparation, frame-vs-crop model pixels/shadows and full App/independent-author output. Shared atlas frame preparation: docs/scene/capabilities/render-graph-shader-coverage.md#material-atlas-source-frames. Original Loader Admission carries prepared frames to static/animated consumers; retire single-only source projection and Catalog duplicate admission. Preserve actual decoded-source ranges and typed metadata versus read/cancel failure. Reader owns finite/index/duration checks once; retire false Float total overflow before the existing bounded Double clock. No new owner/state/cache/Format mutation or per-frame work; require real Catalog two-frame source pixels/App and unchanged static model input/output before slot0 migration.

Source-free quad: docs/scene/capabilities/effect-execution-coverage.md#source-free-quad. These linked contracts own the design details; this registry only routes implementation. Named source local raster: DesignDoc#named-geometry-local-raster. Ordinary non-solid graph providers use their resolved source extent for their existing prepared graph-output provider role, without world/parent column lengths in shared target sizing. Preserve nonnamed terminal density quantization, source coordinates/Resolution, captured matrix, 2048 cap and the original graph/publication/output owners. Retire only provider world-size inflation; qualify stripe pixels and real publication/consumer dimensions under scale, equivalent parent and resource/variable renames, plus ordinary density/raw named/Geometry negatives and real waterdrop background. Qualify actual parser full1/3/5/16 values and prepared model material plus equal-value real model Metal/terminal control; no new general uniform-array or matrix-GPU capability. Ordinary camera-depth contract: docs/scene/capabilities/advanced-object-coverage.md#perspective-image-terminal-depth. Existing preparedImageMaterialFacts prepares nonwriting ordinary image PMA terminal states once, preserving authored tests/order and original source/Program ownership. Retire hot sort state copies, duplicate terminal equality fallback and native-image capability-only replay skip; keep actual native-solid Program replay. Native text remains the existing writing-pipeline consumer until its transparency ordering can preserve real prefix/Program/particle barriers. Ordinary main terminals may establish the original pass/CB depth domain after known mandatory allocation prefix even if the first named model is not color-ready; later models reuse that lease. Retire only the ready-model permission gate, keep partial framebuffer-source exclusion, no partial prepared publication and sticky failure/clear/lifetime. Qualify named-first direct/effect/renamed text, occlusion and late-model reuse plus existing pressure negatives. Validate actual image controls, renamed/sorting/FX/native-solid/neutrals, original366 title recovery and unchanged345 clock/date; glyph official probes qualify the queued ordering gap, not a current text migration.

Reuse current CP conversion and original root/child reference offsets based on actual consumer demand. No raw-flag combination admission, sample/path dispatch, new per-particle history or second CP owner. Existing CP demand and explicit work consume that same plan; no new owner, cache, shared mutable simulator, clock or live accounting. Require frozen optimized equivalence and measured benefit before retaining the candidate. Event inheritance contract: docs/scene/capabilities/particle-component-coverage.md#event-value-inheritance. Replace color-only raw-key admission with typed operations and the existing runtime event context projection of color/size/alpha. Preserve original snapshots/follow refresh, local unavailable writers and final birth checks; retire whole-template admission and duplicate initializer permission.
